asgi_exceptions.cause: an unpinned /api/rollup read during discovery: the timed adapter retried a moved version four times, then raised VersionUnavailableError, which the route does not handle. Adapter c03c8851 and later retry with back-off instead; firstread-* records zero such exceptions with it.
asgi_exceptions.source: server logs of the recorded tree runs (adapter c19ea02d)

method: Each trial runs four arms in a rotated order (python-A, fdu-A, python-B, fdu-B); A/A is the B/A ratio of one provider within one trial; paired is fdu/python for the same arm letter within one trial. Every server run is a fresh `metab` process through the same launcher shim and interpreter.

caveats: attached_rollup_* and attached_rollup_requests are not comparable: bench_serving's startup probe inside Server.__enter__ absorbed every rollup fdu could not answer during discovery, so fdu's one timed rollup came after settle; use attached_first_count_s.
cpu_s values come from `ps time`, which has one-second resolution.
